intent:
"yes approbe and begin the implementation" started the bstack build slice by slice, strictly one at a time ("keep it sequential"). Later: "i'm only not concerned about security hardening, threat-model concerns. Style and simplification and following proper design principles are still important." - build the full app fast, but review the core properly so slices and phases do not leave bugs. For real agent evaluation runs the captain approved: "per evaluation run, copy the existing Codex login into a throwaway isolated home, delete it immediately after the run, never printed or committed."

The plans of record are in the repo: `docs/design.md` (requirements and decisions, including R24: licensing is out of scope) and `docs/implementation-plan.md` (tasks, task evidence contract). knowttl/bstack is public, has no GitHub Actions or workflows and no release automation, and ships through the no-mistakes pipeline with automatic merge of green work. Landed: Phase 0 and all of Phase 1 (T1.1-T1.7), last https://github.com/knowttl/bstack/pull/19 and the end-of-Phase-1 check fixes https://github.com/knowttl/bstack/pull/20.

This piece is slice C11a, the first slice of Phase 2: task T2.1 "Write the research briefs and the citation check". Done evidence: correct, wrong and stale citations; no-web limits; discovery-only transcripts in the available modes.
amendments: Firstmate authorised the separate T1.7 prerequisite timeout and full-capture fixes; fresh completed intent evidence is retained separately.
Final usage, docs and Progress committed before the recorded clean installs and validation.

cases.procedure: Actual general-purpose subagents ran documents, architecture and checks concurrently, then language and outside on reused workers after a fourth-thread limit. Relevant host traces independently establish delegation.
Real isolated TypeScript and Python discovery runs disabled subagent tools and ran all five common-format briefs sequentially in main-thread mode.

Shipped cite-check CLI rejects missing paths, out-of-range lines and stale hashes or revision bytes; correct file and web metadata pass. Real agent reports had sources reopened and citations checked before use.
Actual worker trace commands read scoped sources only; main thread handles report writes in scratch and citation checking. All fixture Git statuses unchanged.
Every discovery run records author-imposed no-web capability and marks language and outside recommendations not researched with reason, retaining repo evidence and general principles.

limitations: Local tests establish Linux and Node 24 only.
Real discovery runs evaluated 441d6c0286757325f2e409a84e0099e15f64ac70; the sourceRevision records the final documentation commit used for clean installs and automated checks.
Web was unavailable by author constraint; no external recommendations were researched. Web metadata tests do not claim source fetching.
Full-test output artifact retains the final captured portion and TAP totals, not the complete earlier streamed output. T2.1 output is complete.
Redacted transcripts preserve line numbers; conversation hashes bind retained redacted bytes. Task-local delegation traces are relevant-event excerpts, not complete host state.
Discovery is not complete audit execution, native fixture verification, protected apply or approved recommendations.
